interface.signature: ladoos(root: TreeNode, home: int, K: int) -> int

preconditions.description: The root of the tree must be an instance of TreeNode.
The home node value must be a positive integer.
The maximum distance K must be an integer between 1 and 20.

postconditions.description: The function returns the maximum number of ladoos Chhota Bheem can eat within a distance K from his home.
